dimensions.name: Artifact Comprehension
dimensions.purpose: Check whether the persona understands what the artifact is saying.
discussion_questions: What do you think this artifact is trying to say?
What is the main message you take away?
Which part was instantly clear?
Which part confused you?
What would you explain to a friend after seeing this?

dimensions.name: Brand Relevance
dimensions.purpose: Check whether the artifact feels appropriate for the brand.
discussion_questions: Does this feel like something this brand should say?
What does this make you think about the brand?
Does this improve, weaken, or not change your view of the brand?
Could another brand say the same thing?
What kind of brand does this artifact make the company feel like?

dimensions.name: Personal Relevance
dimensions.purpose: Check whether the persona feels the artifact is meant for someone like them.
discussion_questions: Does this feel made for someone like you?
Where in your life would this become relevant?
What problem of yours does this speak to?
What feels distant or not meant for you?
Who do you think this is really targeting?

dimensions.name: Emotional Resonance
dimensions.purpose: Decode what the artifact makes the persona feel.
discussion_questions: What did this make you feel?
Did it make you feel understood?
Did it reassure you or create doubt?
Did it make the product feel more desirable?
What emotional moment stayed with you?

dimensions.name: Persuasion Strength
dimensions.purpose: Check whether the artifact moves the persona closer to action.
discussion_questions: Did this make you more interested?
What made it convincing?
What stopped it from being convincing?
Did it change your mind in any way?
What would need to be added to make it more persuasive?

dimensions.name: Trust and Credibility
dimensions.purpose: Check whether the persona believes the artifact.
discussion_questions: Do you believe what this artifact is claiming?
What proof would you need?
What feels exaggerated?
What feels credible?
What would make you trust this more?

dimensions.name: Benefit Recognition
dimensions.purpose: Check whether the persona understands the value being offered.
discussion_questions: What benefit is being promised?
Is that benefit important to you?
Is the benefit functional, emotional, social, or financial?
What problem does this solve?
Is the benefit strong enough to make you act?

dimensions.name: Distinctiveness Versus Competitors
dimensions.purpose: Check whether the artifact creates difference.
discussion_questions: Does this feel different from competitors?
Which competitor does this remind you of?
Could any other brand say the same thing?
What feels ownable?
What makes this stand out or blend in?

dimensions.name: Purchase Trial Consideration Intent
dimensions.purpose: Measure whether the artifact creates behavioural intent.
discussion_questions: Would this make you consider buying?
Would you search for this brand after seeing it?
Would you try this once?
Would you pay more for this?
What would stop you at checkout?

dimensions.name: Friction and Barrier Detection
dimensions.purpose: Identify what could block conversion.
discussion_questions: What would stop you from acting on this?
What feels risky?
What feels like too much effort?
What would you need before deciding?
What hesitation would remain even if you liked it?

dimensions.name: Confusion Rejection and Misinterpretation Risk
dimensions.purpose: Catch harmful or unintended readings.
discussion_questions: What could someone misunderstand here?
What could backfire?
What feels off?
What part could create rejection?
What might people make fun of or ignore?

dimensions.name: Cultural and Social Fit
dimensions.purpose: Check whether the artifact works in the persona's social world.
discussion_questions: Does this fit your cultural context?
Would your family understand or approve of this?
Would this work in your city or community?
Does the language feel natural?
Would you feel comfortable sharing this?

dimensions.name: Occasion and Use-Case Fit
dimensions.purpose: Check where the artifact fits in real behaviour.
discussion_questions: When would this become relevant to you?
What occasion does this fit best?
What would trigger you to act?
Is this for daily use, emergency, gifting, family, status, or special occasions?
Where would you expect to see this?

dimensions.name: Visual and Sensory Response
dimensions.purpose: Decode reaction to the artifact's look, feel and sensory cues.
discussion_questions: What did you notice first visually?
What does the design make you feel?
Does it look premium, trustworthy, cheap, modern, safe, warm, etc.?
What visual detail helps or hurts?
What would you change visually?

dimensions.name: Language and Tone Response
dimensions.purpose: Test the copy, wording and voice.
discussion_questions: Which words stood out?
What felt natural or unnatural?
Is the tone right for you?
Is the claim easy to repeat?
What line would you change?

dimensions.name: Call-to-Action Strength
dimensions.purpose: Check whether the artifact tells the persona what to do next.
discussion_questions: What would you do next after seeing this?
Is the next step clear?
Would you click, search, visit, call, save, share, or ignore?
What would make the CTA stronger?
What feels missing before you act?

dimensions.name: Memory and Recall
dimensions.purpose: Check whether the artifact sticks.
discussion_questions: What do you remember most?
Which brand was this for?
What phrase or image stayed with you?
What would you forget?
Could you recall this tomorrow?

dimensions.name: Audience Fit and Segment Performance
dimensions.purpose: Identify who the artifact works for and who it loses.
discussion_questions: Who would respond best to this?
Who would ignore or reject this?
Does this work for your segment?
What kind of person is most likely to act?
Which persona should this be optimized for?

dimensions.name: Competitive Switching Logic
dimensions.purpose: Test whether the artifact can make someone move from another brand.
discussion_questions: Would this make you switch from your current brand?
What does your current brand still do better?
What would make this worth trying instead?
Is the difference strong enough?
What proof would you need to switch?

dimensions.name: Price and Value Perception
dimensions.purpose: Understand whether the artifact justifies cost.
discussion_questions: What price range does this make you expect?
Does it feel worth paying for?
Would you pay a premium?
What makes it feel expensive or good value?
Would an offer or bundle change your mind?

dimensions.name: Proof and Evidence Need
dimensions.purpose: Identify what evidence would unlock trust.
discussion_questions: What proof would make this believable?
Would expert endorsement help?
Would customer reviews help?
What kind of demo would convince you?
What claim needs evidence?

dimensions.name: Social Spread and Advocacy
dimensions.purpose: Check whether the artifact creates conversation or sharing.
discussion_questions: Would you share this with someone?
Who would you talk to about this?
Would this create conversation?
Would you recommend this?
What would make it worth sharing?

dimensions.name: Channel and Placement Fit
dimensions.purpose: Understand where the artifact should appear.
discussion_questions: Where would this feel most natural?
Would this work on Instagram, YouTube, WhatsApp, retail, TV, outdoor, app or website?
Where would you trust it most?
Where would you ignore it?
What channel would make it more credible?

dimensions.name: Decision Journey Fit
dimensions.purpose: Map whether the artifact works at the right stage.
discussion_questions: Is this useful when first discovering the brand?
Is this useful when comparing options?
Is this useful before purchase?
Is this useful after purchase?
What decision stage does this serve best?

dimensions.name: Behavioural Prediction
dimensions.purpose: Predict likely real-world action, not just stated liking.
discussion_questions: What would you actually do after seeing this?
Would you act now or later?
Where would you drop off?
Would you compare before deciding?
Who would you consult?

dimensions.name: Artifact-Specific Dimensions
dimensions.purpose: Add dimensions depending on artifact type.

ad_creative.name: Ad Creatives
ad_creative.description: Video ads, display ads, social media ads, TV commercials

product_concept.description: New product ideas, prototypes, product descriptions

packaging.name: Packaging
packaging.description: Physical packaging design, labels, unboxing experience

landing_page.name: Landing Pages
landing_page.description: Website landing pages, product pages, conversion pages

claim.name: Claims
